title: SharedCheck
description: Generic check that may leave a lab. assay + rule + reason only; no protocol text or raw data.

assay.description: Assay type key, e.g. ribogreen-ee. Must match checks/<assay>.md.

reason.description: Why the rule exists scientifically, still generic.

library_version.description: Semver of checks/<assay>.md when this rule was published.
